question: What mechanism is proposed to gate the introduction of new tombstone semantics and additional record fields during rolling upgrades for the remote log segment metadata topic in tiered storage?

trace.answer:
The mechanism proposed to gate the introduction of new tombstone semantics and additional record fields during rolling upgrades for the remote log segment metadata topic is gating by the cluster metadata version, where the feature is only enabled once the cluster metadata version is upgraded to the version that introduces it.

Supporting facts:
- At 2026-01-20T01:59:54.000000Z, Lijun Tong stated that the solution is that the feature is gated by the metadata version [mail:34fc284fbaae3665c418057e].
- At 2026-01-20T01:59:54.000000Z, Lijun Tong stated that the new tombstone semantics and the additional fields (for example in RemoteLogSegmentUpdateRecord) are only enabled once the cluster metadata version is upgraded to the version that introduces this feature [mail:34fc284fbaae3665c418057e].
- At 2026-01-20T01:59:54.000000Z, Lijun Tong stated that as long as the cluster metadata version is not bumped, the system will not produce tombstone records, so during rolling upgrades (mixed 4.2/4.3 brokers) the feature remains effectively disabled [mail:34fc284fbaae3665c418057e].
- At 2026-01-20T01:59:54.000000Z, Lijun Tong stated that tombstones will only start being produced after the metadata version is upgraded, at which point all brokers are already required to support the new behavior, and since Kafka does not support metadata version downgrades at the moment, once a metadata version that supports this feature is enabled, it cannot be downgraded to a version that does not support it [mail:34fc284fbaae3665c418057e].

What could not be determined: Nothing; the finding fully answers the question.

  Hey Kamal, Thanks for raising these questions. Here are my responses to your questions: Q1 and Q2: I think both questions boil down to how to release this new feature, both questions are valid concerns. The solution I have in mind is this feature is *gated by the metadata version*. The new tombstone semantics and the additional fields (for example in RemoteLogSegmentUpdateRecord) are only enabled once the cluster metadata version is upgraded to the version that introduces this feature. As long as the cluster metadata version is not bumped, the system will not produce tombstone records. Therefore, during rolling upgrades (mixed 4.2/4.3 brokers), the feature remains effectively disabled. Tombstones will only start being produced after the metadata version is upgraded, at which point all brokers are already required to support the new behavior. Since Kafka does not support metadata version downgrades at the moment, once a metadata version that supports this feature is enabled, it cannot be downgraded to a version that does not support it. I will add these details to the KIP later. Q3. This is an *editing mistake* in the KIP. Thanks for pointing it out — the enum value has already been corrected in the latest revision to remove the unused placeholder and keep the state values contiguous and consistent. Q4. I don't foresee the quota mechanism will interfere with the state transition in any way so far, let me know if any concern hits you.
